cards.label: Bermondsey — James's unit
cards.text: James has the ledger page you took home pinned flat under a jar. He taps the figures without looking at them.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "Seeding is yours to do. I can't hold your hand through it, and I wouldn't if I could. It has to learn you, not me."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "Do it at home, at your own bench. If it takes, bring it here. It'll need a Movement before it's anything but an ornament."
He folds the page back into your hand and goes back to his pearls. That appears to be the lesson.
